notes.title: New Features and Platform
notes.content:
This new major update includes:
- Mac version (OS X 10.13)
- Steam Achievements functionality
- Steam Cloud 
- re-balanced unites attack, defense and other
- re-balanced units damage system
- various small improvements and bug fixes
- improved stability

Please note that due to technical difficulties, the multiplayer has been disabled from this version onward. We apologize to all players for the inconvenience and we thank you for understanding.
Hot-Seat is still available to play on the same device.
